spans.text: The followers of the daiyokai Samaru are known as the Blackwind, and congregate in a temple sharing that name in the Realm of Shadows. Here, they serve under Samaru and tend to his needs, while training to strengthen themselves. These followers see Samaru as something to be worshipped like a god, praising him as an eternal idol. Many who serve at this temple eventually transform into yurei’adria due to Samaru’s corruptive influence, but nonetheless stay loyal to him.
